description: Schedule a new Delta Meeting. Returns the meeting object including its ID and the URL of the running meeting page. Pass team_id to put it on a specific team, or team_id null for a personal meeting on no team; omit it and it lands on the organization's default team.

team_id.description: Team the meeting belongs to. Omit for the org's default team; pass null for a personal meeting on no team.

name: create_meeting
